name: keenable-search
description: Search the web and read pages as clean markdown with Keenable's hosted MCP server. No account or API key is required for anonymous, rate-limited search and fetch; an optional X-API-Key header raises the limits.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP server. No account or key needed; anonymous access is rate limited. Add an X-API-Key header for higher limits.

tools.name: search_web_pages
tools.description: Search the web and return relevant pages with snippets, with optional site, excluded-domain, and publish-date filters.

tools.name: fetch_page_content
tools.description: Fetch a URL as clean markdown, optionally extracting only the part that answers a prompt.

examples.title: Find and read documentation
examples.description: Search for official documentation, then fetch a relevant source page.
examples.prompt: Find the official Python documentation for asyncio TaskGroup and read the relevant page.
